quest.title: Pioneers
quest.description: You catch sight of Columbina in the distance on a deserted island on the east side of Piramida. Worried that your friend has encountered trouble, you chase after her, and in so doing, embark on an adventure into the unknown...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (What... happened...?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Right, there was an accident on board the spaceship... We got into the escape pods... Did we make moonfall successfully?)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It seems like I'm still in my escape pod... I need to make sure Paimon's alright...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Exit the escape pod.)

talks.objective: Find a way to return to the surface

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohhh, Paimon just knew you'd be okay!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How are you feeling, Paimon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not good at all! When Paimon came out of her escape pod, you two were gone... Paimon was scared half to death!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's all good now that she's found you, though! Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now then, let Paimon give you a quick once-over! Are you hurt or anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm fine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that's a relief! Who could have imagined that ancient ship would run into problems... Wait, no, we totally should've seen this coming...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It was buried underground for who knows how many years, after all. It's a miracle that bucket of bolts could even fly!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew... Whatever. The ride was kinda awful... but we still made moonfall in the end...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's dragon-tech for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon blames Eggie for distracting us! We totally neglected to give the spaceship a good looking over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of Eggie... Where is she? Paimon remembers she got into an escape pod, too.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We have to find her.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah. Paimon hopes she's okay!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Success! Well, that was easier than Paimon expected.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But we still need to activate the third station, right?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Look... It's already active.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, you're right... It still works, after all this time? Dragon tech sure is reliable...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Someone else might have activated it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Someone else? You mean... Columbina? After all, who else could it be... But why did she only activate one?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You don't think... she found out something was wrong? Are we gonna run into some sort of problem?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey... Eggie, you're not misleading us again, are you? This one's coming out of your friendship level!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I don't know... what my mission is...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: But I'm sure it doesn't include... raising anyone's friendship levels...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Eggie, you've changed! Did all that info from the terminals go to your head?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's check out the Eye of Ibni-Belum first, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: #Hmm... {NICKNAME}... more rational... reliable... good thinker... a superior partner... unlike Paimon...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: #Let's go... {NICKNAME}... I'll walk with you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Okay, that's it! Paimon's deducting another ten percent from your share of the snacks!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look! There's an escape pod! This must be Eggie's one, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But she doesn't seem to be in there... She must've made it out safely.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could she have escaped into this ruin-like place...? We should go inside and look for her.

talks.objective: Look for Eggie within the ruins
Look for Eggie within the ruins
Look for Eggie within the ruins
Look for Eggie within the ruins
Look for Eggie within the ruins
Look for Eggie within the ruins

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eggie! We're here to rescue you!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: ...Let me go...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Eggie, wake up! It's us!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: ...You... Let go of me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Snap out of it! We're here to rescue you! You're safe now!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Oh...! Oh... I'm sorry... It's you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How did you get captured by those things? Do you know what this place is?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: ...I don't know... but...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: ...Please let me... access the terminal...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Terminal? What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: ...It's at the entrance... It has... information...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! Is that the thingamajig we saw on our way in? Let's go find it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this the terminal you were talking about, Eggie?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Yes...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Ahh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Nin... Nin...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sorry, what?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: My name...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So the terminal's got your name in it? And you're called Ninnin?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The moons' power... can record... information...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: It is... stored in the terminal...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! So you can read the information in the terminal? Then, you know what this place is?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: It's an energy generation station... used to produce... and store energy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So those glowing orbs from earlier must have been some sorta energy, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You must've been taken away to be used as an energy source because you have the same power...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this energy generation station used for?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: To power... the Eye of Ibni-Belum...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Eye... of Ibni-Belum? What's that? Sounds kinda familiar.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was one of the spaceship landing sites.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The... Eye of Ibni-Belum? What's that supposed to be?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Here are the engineering blueprints... let me show you...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The tall tower in the middle... That is the Eye...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, that's so cool! What about the three shorter towers? Are they energy generators?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Yes... We're inside one of them right now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What exactly does this Eye of Ibni-Belum do?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The work logs record that... it is a lunar surface monitoring station... capable of monitoring the entire lunar surface.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Monitor the lunar surface? That's amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then... doesn't that mean it could help us search for Columbina's whereabouts?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I don't know... but... It's possible...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like we're taking a trip over there then.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: We've already activated... this one...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So that means we still have to deal with the other two, right? No problem! We've done this kind of thing tons of times.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, Eggie. Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Not Eggie... I'm Ninnin...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, you can be both.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Just Ninnin...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, alright, so you're Ninnin, aka Eggie. Does that work?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I'm just Ninnin...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Meet Paimon in the middle here, would ya!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't forget you got us stranded in this wasteland where there's not a single restaurant in sight... Do you still want your snacks or not!?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Alright... I'm Ninnin, aka Eggie...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, what was that about snacks?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, uh, that's between Paimon and Ninnin!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon! We need to head to the other stations!

talks.objective: Search for other energy generation stations

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This terminal's been left out here all by itself... Poor thing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it the energy generation station's terminal? Why don't you give it a try, Eggie?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How's it looking? Any new intel?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: This is the energy generation station terminal... but... I retrieved no new information...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Even though we didn't find any new intel, we still managed to activate station number two. Paimon would say that's a job well done!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Wait... Signal locator malfunction detected... Energy cannot be transmitted to the Eye of Ibni-Belum.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What are we going to do?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The signal locator... is at the top of the tower... It requires manual adjustment...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Then let's figure out a way to get up there and check it out.

talks.objective: Go to the top to adjust the signal locator
Head for The Eye of Ibni-Belum

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So this is the Eye of Ibni-Belum? It definitely feels like a special place...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! The terminal's over there.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I think... I'll get some useful information.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph, let's hope it doesn't puff your head up even more.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—What just happened?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I activated... the Eye of Ibni-Belum...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? Did it work? Can you find Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Hmm... in the facility known as Ungien's Circle... the terminal has detected...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: ...The appearance of an unknown individual lacking an identification code...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could that be Columbina?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The system cannot confirm this person's identity...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like we have to check it out in person.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... We can't be totally sure, but at least we have a lead for now... So, how are we gonna get there?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Let me help... Look... we can use this to get across...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! What is this?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: It's the entrance to the high-speed transit lane... it runs on the ancient moons' power...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Through it... you can reach the next stop from the Eye of Ibni-Belum... Ungien's Circle...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The terminal records state that... many species of creatures live there... it is a home for living beings...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, there are all kinds of creatures living on the moon? That's incredible...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Should we head out now?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Please wait a moment... Something in the terminal is still responding to me...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Ah!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eggie, what's wrong!?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: There is a hidden module... "Project Moongazer"... It responded to me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any new intel?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The module... records the origins of this tower...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: It starts with a dragon pioneer named Ibni{RUBY#[S]the first Moongazer}-Belum...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The lunar vessel we traveled in... was his creation... He was the one who led dragon researchers to the moon...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: W—Wow, that's amazing! So this place must've been built to commemorate him, right?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Not exactly... The terminal recorded this instead...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: After the pioneer landed... he began to explore the moon and circumlunar zone...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Then, one day... while in the circumlunar zone, he received a... mysterious signal from deep space...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A signal from deep space? What was it?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The researchers couldn't decipher the signal's meaning...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: But the pioneer believed... it was a message sent back... by their king who had journeyed out into the sea of stars...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: And that king's name... was Nibelung.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—The Dragon King!? Did the signal really come from him?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I don't know... because the researchers could not enter deep space...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: So... they built this tower...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: This place, the Eye... It was originally a deep-space signal transceiver station... built to recapture that signal...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And... did they succeed?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: Many years went by... the pioneer passed away... but the signal never appeared again...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: His students gave up years later... and turned to more practical pursuits.

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: They renovated the Eye into a lunar surface monitoring station... to make it easier for them to conduct more practical lunar research...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww, what a shame... Wow, Paimon feels like we just stumbled on something super important...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And this is "Project Moongazer"?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: No... these are just the log entries I read...

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: The real project file is encrypted... I can't open it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Didn't you say it responded to you? Shouldn't you be able to, y'know, open it?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: My data matches it... but maybe because... it isn't enough...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err, sorry, what do you mean by "isn't enough"!?

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: It's like how... snacks and Paimon are a match... but twenty percent of the snacks won't be enough for Paimon to eat.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, you're the one who gets twenty percent. Paimon's getting eighty!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like Eggie is a key mold of sorts.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Some content is missing, so a key can't be forged.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Yeah, Paimon feels like that's exactly it! Come to think of it, could this "Project Moongazer" be connected to Eggie's mission?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It responded to Eggie's message. In fact, it feels almost like it was waiting for her to show up!

dialogues.speaker: Eggie
dialogues.text: I don't know... but I want to... open it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then let us help you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If there's not enough information, then we just need to go find more terminals, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon noticed that with every terminal Eggie absorbs, she speaks a little more smoothly — and gets a little more full of herself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: While Paimon could certainly do without the attitude, if this is Eggie's mission, then Paimon's gonna help!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Heh! Well, Eggie did help us look for Columbina, didn't she?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, Eggie! Since there's a terminal here, there's gotta be more up ahead! Come with us, and we'll make sure you get plenty to eat.

response.speaker: Eggie
response.text: Thank you... Paimon... I'll try my best... not to puff up...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehehe. So, should we head to the next stop now?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! Second stop on our super awesome lunar adventure — the "Ungi-Ungi Circle"! Let's go!
